display.purpose: Page-level titles on dashboard screens; used sparingly.

title.purpose: Navbar links, button labels, card headers.

body.purpose: General interface text, forms, cell content at rest.

table.purpose: Dense grid cell content; the workhorse role.

label.purpose: Column-filter selects, micro-labels, uppercase status text.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating chrome only: popovers, dropdowns, dialogs. Never on the table floor.

motion.name: ease-badge
motion.purpose: Status badges, page buttons, export buttons, column resizer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The engaged-switch action. Near-black fill, 10px radius, 32px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(1 0 0); height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; outline: none; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not([aria-haspopup]) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Paper fill, hairline border, muted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; outline: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Nav Pill
components.description: Primary navigation. Solid Instrument Blue, the console's live signal.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0f62fe; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-pill:hover { background: #0353e9; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dense form field. 32px tall, hairline border, unmistakable focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 10px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: oklch(0.97 0 0 / 0.5); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Order status as a soft-tinted pill. Submitted shown; each status owns a same-hue tint pair.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 0 10px; background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-badge.won { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; border-color: #a7f3d0; } .ds-badge.lost { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; border-color: #fecaca; } .ds-badge.eval { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border-color: #fde68a; }

components.name: Active Page Button
components.description: Pagination control. Active page lit in Instrument Blue; the rest paper with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-page { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 28px; min-width: 28px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-page:hover:not(:disabled) { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-page.active { background: #0f62fe; color: #ffffff; border-color: #0f62fe; } .ds-page:disabled { opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Column Filter Select
components.description: Per-column header filter. 24px tall, 10px type, dense.
components.css: .ds-colfilter { width: 100%; height: 24px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; outline: none; } .ds-colfilter:focus { border-color: #94a3b8; }

narrative.overview:
The GMD quotation dashboard is an instrument panel for pricing valves. The interface is a neutral, engineered chassis - paper-white surfaces, near-black ink, hairline borders - and the single loud color, Instrument Blue (#0f62fe), behaves like a live indicator light: it marks where the operator is, what is actionable, and what has switched on. Every blue element is a signal, never decoration.

The system is built for the day's load: dense data tables with 10-13px type, 24-36px hit targets, resizable columns, and inline editing. Density is a feature. The screen reads like gauges on a console - calm, evenly lit, each row scannable at a glance - rather than like a brochure or a dashboard mock. Controls are dense and decisive: small, clearly bordered, with unmistakable pressed and focused states. Focus is a first-class citizen (3px ring at 50% opacity), because most work here happens on the keyboard.

Depth is lightly lifted. Surfaces are flat by default; modest separation comes from hairline borders and muted washes. Shadows appear only where something genuinely floats above the table plane - sticky bars, popovers, dropdowns, the navbar. The table itself never casts a shadow; it is the floor of the console.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral chassis, one signal color (Instrument Blue) plus emerald reserved for admin.
Dense by design: small type, small targets, many rows visible per screen.
Flat surfaces with light lift for floating chrome only.
Every interactive element announces its state clearly (hover, focus, active, disabled).
Poppins everywhere, tight tracking, labels uppercase and small.
Light theme is canonical; a full neutral dark theme ships and inverts the chassis.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: On any given screen, Instrument Blue appears on fewer than 10% of pixels. Its rarity is what makes it read as a live indicator. When more than one element needs to be "on," they must compete or the blue loses meaning.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Table text is 13px and never grows for readability alone; density is the point. If a value cannot be read at 13px, the row layout is wrong, not the font size.

rules.name: The Flat-Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the data table casts a shadow. If a surface needs to feel separate from the table, separate it with a border or a muted wash first, and reach for a shadow only when it floats.

dos: Do use Instrument Blue for navigation, active states, and live signals - and nowhere else.
Do keep table type at 13px and let density win over readability theater.
Do show focus on every interactive element (3px ring, 50% ring color).
Do keep surfaces flat; use hairline borders and muted washes before shadows.
Do use the status pill pairs verbatim - tinted backgrounds with same-hue darker text.
Do reserve emerald for admin-only actions.
donts: Don't let any decorative element take Instrument Blue; it is a signal, not a theme.
Don't cast shadows on the data table or its rows.
Don't introduce a second display font; Poppins carries every role.
Don't grow table text past 13px for readability; fix the layout instead.
Don't add circles, gradients, or irregular silhouettes to the control vocabulary - rectangles and pills only.
Don't style new work on /raw_material from the global tokens; use its scoped Material 3 palette.
